GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2013-01-08T02:38:54Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: `route` event now fired by router and history
Description: Since PR #2062 got merged into master there are now two places that `route` is triggered:
1.  On the router 
2.  On BB.History

It seems odd to me that there is an identical event name being triggered in two different locations.

Is there a particular reason why this behavior is desired?
